messages:
nikita: Heads-up: starting next week's experiment for a Fast-Track lane on the release train. Goal: safely accelerate low-risk infra / tooling rollouts while keeping strict safety gates for model-serving changes. Read summary below.

yara: Nice. What defines "low-risk" for the lane?

ikita: Low-risk = non-model codepaths, client libs, SDKs, infra tooling with zero user-facing API change and automated rollback tests. Criteria in the runbook. Fast-Track will have a tighter canary (1 rack) and automated 15m smoke + metrics check.

pablo: How does this affect the freeze window? Will we still enforce EOQ-style freezes?

ikita: Fast-Track is allowed during normal train freezes but not during embargoes tied to infra incidents. For EOQ/major freezes we'll still block it. We added a short exception flow for urgent infra fixes.

release-bot: New policy draft: fast-track lane enabled (experiment) by nikita at 2026-09-12T10:05Z.

toni: Ops concerns: shorter canary means higher automation dependency. Ops will require the automated rollback to be exercised in CI for the PR. Also infra-oncall will get a webhook alert and an optional pause window.

infra-oncall: Confirmed. We'll add an alert policy and a one-click abort from the ops dashboard. Also adding a daily 10:00 UTC readout during the experiment.

nikita: Exception deploy command if you need to bypass the lane block:
```
/fast-permit --pr <URL> --owner <name> --reason "emergency infra fix" --approver @release-mgr
```
Must attach smoke-test script and rollback SHA.

yara: Will we change rollout metrics? Suggest adding deployment success rate and time-to-rollback to the train dashboard.

pablo: Agreed. Also tracking user-facing error budget delta for the hour after roll.

ikita: Runbook link (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fast-track-lane-experiment. Experiment period: 2 weeks starting Mon 09:00 UTC. We'll report findings at the weekly train retro.

release-bot: Fast-Track experiment: start Mon 09:00 UTC for 14 days. Auto-unfreeze rules unchanged.

toni: Ok. Teams: if you plan to opt-in, follow the checklist in the runbook and ping @release-mgr before creating the PR. We'll keep the thread open for questions.
